headline: IAEA Referrals Iran Nuclear File to UN Security Council Over 200kg Enriched Uranium
subheadline: IAEA Board referred Iran's nuclear file to UN Security Council noting over 200kg highly enriched uranium survived bombings as US prepares military action
lede: The IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council, citing over 200 kilograms of highly enriched uranium that survived recent bombings. President Trump declared the US is not seeking negotiations with Iran, claiming nine oil tankers were struck and further attacks are planned. Meanwhile, Israel elevated Iran as the primary war theater, warning of a potential multi-front conflict involving Lebanon and Yemen, as Yemeni forces advanced on the western coast and Saudi mercenaries surrendered.

sections.title: Eastern Front Intensifies Ballistic and Drone Assault
sections.body: Russian forces launched ballistic missile threats from the Kursk region, including Iskander-M, S-300, and Tsirkon systems, targeting Ukraine. Multiple reactive Shahed drones struck Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Sumy, Poltava, and Mykolaiv regions. Ground advances were confirmed near Stepanivka and Kotlyne on the eastern front, while a strike on a territorial recruitment center in Sumy killed three people.

sections.title: Iran Nuclear File Referred to UN Council
sections.body: The IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council, noting over 200 kilograms of highly enriched uranium survived bombings. President Trump stated the US is not seeking negotiations with Iran, claiming nine oil tankers were struck and further attacks are planned. Israel elevated Iran as the primary war theater, warning of a potential multi-front conflict involving Lebanon and Yemen. Yemeni Armed Forces advanced toward the western coast, causing Saudi mercenaries to flee and surrender, while IDF airstrikes in Gaza killed senior Hamas commander Ahmad and destroyed weapon caches and rocket sites.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous IAEA referral and US military posturing alongside Iranian defensive demands signal a rapid escalation toward broader conflict. Russian coordinated ballistic missile and Shahed drone campaigns against eight Ukrainian regions reveal a deliberate strategy to degrade air defense capacity. Both theaters demonstrate expanding target sets beyond purely military objectives, including civilian infrastructure and nuclear assets.
